name: deepseek-voice-conversation
description: Standalone DeepSeek Harness voice conversation plugins

scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions -p packages/experimental/voice-speech-doubao/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-voice-speech-doubao bundle && pnpm run generate:remote && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions -p packages/experimental/client-ui-voice-conversation/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-voice-conversation bundle && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions -p packages/experimental/voice-conversation-bundle/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-voice-conversation-bundle bundle
